target.title: Notify on Claude extra-window quota thresholds (Fable, Daily Routines)
target.body:
## Summary

Claude's model-scoped weekly windows (`claude-weekly-scoped-*`, e.g. the promotional **Fable** carve-out) and **Daily Routines** (`claude-routines`) already render in the menu, but they were silent for quota-warning notifications — only the primary session and weekly lanes fired. You can hit 100% on Fable with no heads-up.

This adds a generic notification lane for Claude's extra rate windows, mirroring the existing Antigravity special case in `UsageStore+QuotaWarnings.swift`.

- Generic over the Claude extra-window ids, so a future model carve-out (or Fable's return) surfaces automatically with no code change.
- Reuses the existing **weekly** toggle and thresholds — **no new settings surface** (per the product call in #1123).
- Adds a `windowID` discriminator to `QuotaWarningStateKey` so sibling windows keep independent fired-threshold state instead of clobbering the shared weekly key.
- Notification copy shows the real window name ("Fable only", "Daily Routines"); OS notification ids stay unique per window.
- Prunes fired-threshold state when a scoped window disappears (e.g. the Fable promo ends), so a returning window starts from a clean baseline.
- Excludes Antigravity summary windows (already folded into the primary/weekly lanes) by both provider guard and id filter.

## Scope notes (intentionally out of scope)

- Reuses the `.weekly` toggle, so there's no independent opt-out for extra windows — deliberate, to avoid new settings/menu surface.
- `NamedRateWindow.title` ("Fable only", "Daily Routines") is not localized, so notification bodies show the English label. Consistent with how those titles already render in the menu.

## Commands run

- `swift test --filter UsageStoreSessionQuotaTransitionTests --filter QuotaWarningNotificationLogicTests` → 40 tests, green
- `make check` → SwiftFormat + SwiftLint + locale checks, green

## Tests

- Fable scoped-weekly + Daily Routines each fire an independent weekly warning with distinct `windowID`/label and independent state.
- Antigravity summary extra windows do not trigger the new lane.
- Recovery-then-refire for a scoped window.
- Fired-threshold state is pruned when the window disappears from the payload.
- Notification copy renders the extra-window display label.
